theorem lg_target (p : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 1 - p := by
    rw [sub_nonneg]
    exact h1
  have h3 : 1 - p ≤ 1 := by
    rw [sub_le]
    exact h1
  have h4 : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 * (1 - p) := by
    apply mul_le_left
    exact h3
  have h5 : 1 * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    apply mul_le_right
    exact h2
  exact le_trans h4 h5
